== action canceled effect_possible=true
outcome dispatch.outcome.canceled
  Action close-ticket on agent agent-7 was canceled at 2026-10-08 12:10:00 UTC.
  record=action:act-1 agent=agent-7 request=req-1 correlation=corr-1
  identifiers close-ticket agent-7
reason dispatch.reason.canceled_after_lapse
  It was canceled after its last claim lapsed without a report.
  record=action:act-1
gap dispatch.gap.effect_may
  An external effect may have occurred; reconcile with the target.
  record=action:act-1
history dispatch.history.requested
  alice enqueued it at 2026-10-08 12:00:00 UTC, with a deadline of 2026-10-08 14:00:00 UTC.
  record=action:act-1 principal=alice request=req-1
  identifiers alice
history dispatch.history.claims
  It was claimed once.
  record=action:act-1
history dispatch.history.claimant
  The last claim was held by worker-1.
  record=action:act-1 principal=worker-1 claim=claim-1
  identifiers worker-1
next dispatch.next.canceled
  Nothing further happens to this action; because it was claimed before it was canceled, reconcile with the target before requesting the work again.
  record=action:act-1

  record=action:act-1
